svg.text: SPA-KLT: Adaptive Sparse Optical Flow Tracking for Visual-Inertial Odometry
Fixed KLT: redundant compute on small motion
Fast motion / blur: feature loss & vicious cycle
Loop closure: DBoW2, no motion prior filter
- SPA failure fallback to default KLT
